practice_en: training mandarin fish to accept formulated feed
practice_zh: 鳜鱼饲料驯化(驯食人工配合饲料)

names: transition from live feed to formulated feed
suspended active feed with three-stage training
suspended compound feed and training mode
grouping.reason: Most members describe the core practice of training mandarin fish to switch from live or dead bait to formulated feed, while members on specific settings (small water bodies, recirculating systems, feeding time), carbohydrate acclimation, post-training health or feeding management, gene expression, and feed properties are different topics or practices.

strength.en: Of 87 claims that take a side: 66 in favour, 21 against or no effect. Neither side reaches 80%.
strength.zh: 87 条有明确倾向的论断中，66 条支持，21 条反对或无效果，任何一方都未达到 80%。
strength.rule: one paper; described if more claims describe than take a side; agree or against at 80% or more one way; otherwise mixed

basis.summary: The success-rate claims come from several measured papers and carry the most weight, but the many background, measured and counterevidence claims on low or unstable success, intake, growth, gut and taste changes show the outcome is mixed, so I reported both.

statement_en: Most claims report that mandarin fish, which naturally eat only live prey, can be trained to accept formulated feed in a staged switch from live bait to dead bait to feed, with reported training success mostly around 70–96% and some studies reporting lower figures (47.8%–70%); growth was similar to live-fed fish in two studies. However, results are not uniform: some papers report unstable success, low intake, poor growth or loss of condition, anorexia and sugar-metabolism disorder, lower taste-receptor gene expression, and temporary digestive-enzyme suppression and gut tissue changes after the switch.
statement_zh: 多数研究表明，天然只吃活饵的鳜鱼可以通过从活饵到死饵再到配合饲料的逐步过渡来驯食，驯食成功率多报道在70%～96%左右，也有研究报道较低（47.8%～70%）；有两项研究显示驯化后生长与吃活饵的鱼无显著差异。但结果并不一致：有的报道成功率不稳定、摄食量下降、生长慢或消瘦，部分个体出现厌食和糖代谢紊乱，驯食后味觉受体基因表达下调，转食初期消化酶活性受抑制、肠胃组织结构发生变化。

names: artificial extended light with feeding management

basis.summary: Only two papers; C13866 is marked measured but only describes the feeding procedure, and C9234 is a speculative suggestion, so I described both as practice descriptions or proposals without a confirmed welfare effect, and there was no disagreement.

statement_en: Both claims are supportive but neither reports a measured welfare outcome clearly: one paper describes using shading, flashlight light and water flow together at feeding, and another paper suggests extending light to 8-16 hours and giving enough feed at about 4 days of age to raise feeding and growth.
statement_zh: 两条结论都偏向支持，但都没有明确给出福利方面的实测效果：一篇只是描述投喂时遮光、用手电筒光诱导并配合水流刺激；另一篇建议把光照延长到8-16小时，并在4日龄左右投足饵料，以提高摄食和生长。

statement_en: Most claims say feed attractants and stimulants improve palatability, appetite and feed intake in mandarin fish and help them accept artificial feed during training, but these are mostly stated or cited rather than measured. One paper reports the opposite: attractants only raised the share of feed swallowed once it was already in the mouth, with no gain in attack rate or overall training success.
statement_zh: 多数研究认为，诱食剂能改善饲料适口性、增强食欲、提高采食量，并有助于鳜驯食人工饲料，但这些多为论述或引用，实测的较少。也有一篇文献指出相反的结果：诱食剂只能提高已进入口咽腔饲料的吞咽比例，并不能提高攻击频率，也不能有效提高整体驯食成功率。

basis.summary: C7920 carries the most weight as it is the only measured, supportive claim, while C7643 only describes the method; with just two papers, the evidence is thin and there is no disagreement.

statement_en: One paper measured that making compound feed with minced fish and blood water instead of plain water, using the smell, helped mandarin fish fry adapt well to artificial feed. The other paper only describes attractant-based domestication as using compound feed according to gut structure or feeding preference, without stating a welfare effect.
statement_zh: 有一项研究测得,用搅碎的鱼肉和血水代替清水加工配合饲料,借助其气味,鳜苗能较好地适应人工饲料。另一项研究只是说明诱食驯化是根据鱼的肠道结构或摄食喜好,用配合饲料来驯化,没有给出对福利的具体效果。

statement_en: One paper on mandarin fish reports that automatic feeders work mainly with floating feed. With sinking feed, feed is wasted because the fish feed in the upper layer while the feed sinks. The same paper suggests starting with a little hand feeding to induce feeding, then adding the machine, then topping up by hand as needed.
statement_zh: 一篇关于鳜鱼的研究指出,自动投饵机主要适合投喂浮性饲料;用沉性饲料时,鱼在上层摄食而饲料下沉,会造成饲料浪费。文中建议先少量人工投喂诱食,再配合投饵机,最后视情况人工补投。

practice_en: adequate feeding ration to reduce cannibalism
practice_zh: 足量适度投喂(防自相残杀)

names: feed enough at once and top up
grouping.reason: Both members describe feeding an adequate but not excessive ration so fish are not hungry, which reduces cannibalism in Chinese perch, so they are the same feeding-management practice.

basis.summary: Both claims come from different papers and neither reports measured data (one inferred, one claimed), so they carry similar weight; they agree that enough feed reduces cannibalism, and I noted the second paper's caveat on overfeeding as a limit rather than a conflict.

statement_en: Two papers say that feeding mandarin fish enough reduces cannibalism, which appears when the fish are hungry, and one adds that survival improves when feed is given enough at one time and topped up in good time. The other paper cautions that overfeeding is limited by the water body's carrying capacity and takes up resources.
statement_zh: 两篇文献都认为，鳜鱼只有饥饿时才会自相残杀，投足饵料可以减轻残食；其中一篇提到“一次投足、及时补充”能提高成活率，另一篇则指出投喂过量会受水体承载力限制，并占用资源。

practice_zh: 鳜鱼饵料鱼配套培育与选择

names: co-culturing with bait fish in same pond
grouping.reason: All members concern providing suitable live bait fish to mandarin fish (co-culture, cultivation, selection of palatable healthy bait), while C9470 only lists the drawbacks of bait-fish feeding and is not about the practice itself.

statement_en: The three claims only describe or suggest the practice and report no measured welfare effect. They say bait fish for mandarin fish should suit its feeding (right body size, no hard spines, slow swimming) during training, that choosing live bait well is a key way to make larval rearing more efficient, and that raising bait fish in cages or ponds is proposed because natural bait fish are short while live fish are still the main feed.
statement_zh: 这三条结论都只是描述或建议，没有给出对鳜鱼福利的实测效果。内容是：驯化期选用的饵料鱼要体型合适、无硬棘、游速慢，才便于翘嘴鳜摄食；优化活饵料鱼的选择是提高鳜仔鱼养殖效率的关键途径之一；配合饲料不成熟时仍主要投喂活鱼，而天然饵料鱼不足，因此建议研究用网箱或池塘培育饵料鱼。

names: dynamic feeding and bait fish rearing
grouping.reason: All three members describe adjusting the size, density, top-up and feeding of live bait fish dynamically according to the mandarin fish's growth and feeding, so they are the same practice.

statement_en: Seven papers recommend adjusting how much and how often mandarin fish are fed, mainly to ease food stress, keep feeding stable, avoid gut overload and let most fish get food. Only one paper measured an effect, reporting that lowering feed amount and adjusting frequency in the consolidation stage improved feeding stability; the rest are stated practices with no measured welfare result, and none report disagreement or no effect.
statement_zh: 七篇文献都提到要调整鳜鱼的投喂量和投喂频率，主要是为了减轻摄食压力、保持摄食稳定、避免肠道负担过重，并让大多数鱼都能吃到料。只有一篇做了实测，结果是在巩固期降低投喂量并调整频率后，摄食稳定性有所提高；其余都只是介绍投喂做法，没有实测对福利的影响，各篇之间也没有相互矛盾或无效的结论。

practice_zh: 大豆浓缩蛋白水解物替代鱼粉

basis.summary: The measured claims from both papers (S502 and S067) consistently show linear declines in intake and feed utilisation, which carry the most weight, while the 37.16% no-effect threshold and the mixed gut and liver findings are reported as qualifications rather than as contradictions; the purely descriptive or aim-stating claims were left out.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fish meal with soy protein concentrate hydrolysate lowered feed intake, feed efficiency, protein efficiency and protein retention, and final weight and growth rate fell in a linear way as the replacement level rose. One paper reports no significant negative effect on growth at replacement levels up to 37.16%, but also that liver lipid accumulation increased and pept2 expression dropped above that level, while midgut villus length and muscular layer thickness peaked at the FM35 group.
statement_zh: 在鳜鱼中，用大豆浓缩蛋白水解物替代鱼粉，摄食量、饲料效率、蛋白效率和蛋白沉积率均下降，终末体重和特定生长率也随替代比例升高呈线性下降。有一篇文章指出替代水平不超过37.16%时对生长没有显著不利影响，但肝脏脂肪蓄积增加，超过该水平后pept2表达下降，而中肠绒毛长度和肌层厚度在FM35组最大。

statement_en: All eight claims, from different papers, say that shaping feed like a fish (elongated, rod or spindle form, sized to the fish's mouth, with moderate moisture and slow sinking) should help mandarin fish notice, chase and eat it, which matters for weaning them onto formulated feed. These are stated recommendations or background; none reports a measured welfare outcome.
statement_zh: 八条结论来自不同论文，都认为把饲料做成仿鱼的形状（细长杆状或纺锤形，大小与鳜口裂相配，含水量适中、缓慢下沉），有利于鳜发现、追逐和摄食，对驯化摄食配合饲料有帮助。不过这些都是经验性的建议或背景介绍，没有给出实测的福利效果数据。

basis.summary: Both papers (S279, S348) measured the effects, so the growth and gene-expression claims carry the most weight. statement_en: In two papers, fish fed duckweed instead of chironomid larvae grew better (higher body weight and length, larger intestines) and showed higher transcription of digestive enzyme genes. Appetite-related genes in brain, gut and liver were expressed differently, which the papers read as plant feed affecting appetite. Fish were fed to satiation up to 116 days after hatching, and one paper covers the diet-transition period. The claims name grass carp (草鱼), not mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 两篇研究中，投喂浮萍的鱼比投喂摇蚊幼虫的生长更好（体重、体长更高，肠道更大），消化酶基因转录水平也更高；脑、肠、肝中与食欲相关的基因表达也有差异，研究认为植物性饲料会影响食欲。试验为饱食投喂，持续到孵化后116天，其中一篇针对转食期。需要说明的是，这些结论里的对象是草鱼，不是鳜鱼。

statement_en: In one 2024 study on mandarin fish, adding chlorella, Bacillus subtilis, or both to the feed raised weight gain rate, and the combined group had the lowest feed conversion ratio. Adding either one alone did not clearly lower the feed conversion ratio.

statement_zh: 一项2014年的研究中，在第14至16天逐日用俄勒冈湿性软颗粒逐步替代鲜鱼块的过程中，鳜摄食的软颗粒越来越多；到第17天只投喂软颗粒时，鳜在投喂时马上从水面下抢食。

statement_en: Replacing live bait with formulated feed in mandarin fish gave mixed results: in the one measured study, fish on formulated feed had significantly lower final body weight and specific growth rate and lower protease activity, but higher intestinal amylase activity, than fish on live bait. The authors interpret this as fish maintaining some growth and partly adapting digestively, and two other papers call the switch feasible but say feed nutrition and feeding strategy need optimising to improve growth.
statement_zh: 鳜用配合饲料替代活饵的结果不一：唯一有实测数据的研究显示，配合饲料组翘嘴鳜的终末体质量和特定生长率显著低于活饵组，蛋白酶活力也较低，但肠道淀粉酶活力较高。作者认为鱼仍能维持一定生长，消化器官也有一定程度的适应；另有两篇文献认为替代是可行的，但需要优化饲料营养和投喂策略以提高生长速度。

basis.summary: Both papers measured growth, survival and organ indices directly and agree that low-to-moderate replacement was fine and the highest replacement hurt growth, so I weighted those measured claims and left out the background and design-only claims (C12300, C12548, C12547, C2666, C2668, C2673); the 40% growth peak comes from one paper only, so I stated it as such.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, replacing fishmeal with composite animal and plant proteins at low to moderate levels (about 27% in one paper, 40% in the other) did not harm growth, and 40% gave the highest growth in one paper. At the highest levels tested (54.55% and 80%), growth fell, and one paper also found higher feed conversion ratio and lower digestive enzyme activity; survival, organ indices and feed intake did not differ between groups.
statement_zh: 鳜鱼用复合动植物蛋白替代鱼粉，低至中等水平（一篇约27%，另一篇40%）不影响生长，其中一篇中40%替代组生长最好；替代水平最高时（54.55%和80%）生长下降，一篇还发现饵料系数升高、消化酶活性降低；各组成活率、脏体比、肝体比和摄食量没有显著差异。

basis.summary: All of these claims are measured results from several papers, with C4592, C4741, C5056 and C5057 carrying the most weight for the numbers, while C6831 conflicts with C5056 on W2 digestibility so I flagged it; C4753 was left out because it concerns hilsa shad, not mandarin fish.

statement_en: Across measured trials in mandarin fish, different compound feed formulations gave different growth and feed-efficiency results, and some formulations performed worse than others; compound feeds reached only about 80-82% of live feed on conversion efficiency or intake. In two formulations (W1 and W2), growth rates were nearly the same (0.93% vs 0.91%) while W2 had higher digestibility and protein efficiency in one paper, but another paper reported W2 digestibility as slightly lower than or close to W1, so the digestibility comparison is not fully consistent.
statement_zh: 鳜鱼的实测试验表明，不同配合饲料配方的生长和饲料效率有差异，有的配方明显较差；配合饲料的转化效率或摄食率只有活饵料的约80%～82%。W1和W2两种配方的特定生长率几乎一样（0.93%对0.91%），其中一篇报道W2的消化率和蛋白质效率更高，另一篇则称W2的消化率略低于或接近W1，说明消化率方面的结果并不完全一致。

statement_en: In juvenile mandarin fish, replacing part of the dietary compound protein with compound protein hydrolysate did little harm at 25% (growth and feed intake did not differ from the control, and condition factor was not lower), but at 50% and above feed efficiency fell and condition factor was lower than the control. At 100% replacement, final weight, specific growth rate and feed intake were also significantly lower, while gut histology varied by level (longest midgut villi at 50%, thickest muscle layer at 25%).
statement_zh: 鳜幼鱼用复合蛋白水解物替代部分复合蛋白时，25%替代组的生长和摄食量与对照组无显著差异，肥满度也未降低；替代比例达到50%及以上时，饲料效率下降，肥满度低于对照组（50%组的肥满度低于对照在C16447中有报道，75%和100%组的下降也有报道）。替代100%时，终末体重、特定生长率和摄食量也显著低于对照组；肠道组织学则因替代水平而异（中肠绒毛长度50%组最长，肌层厚度25%组最厚）。

statement_en: Papers describe extruded floating feed for mandarin fish as easy to feed and observe, with less waste, better feed use and a lower feed conversion ratio, and one paper suggests it is more palatable than soft pellets. Two papers also note drawbacks: the fish must rise to the surface to eat, so training them onto the feed takes longer and demands good training and attractiveness, and medicine mixed into it can be lost.

Only a few papers measured this: blind fish swallowed soft pellets but not paste-like balls, and one paper found fine-textured, long soft extruded feed preferred while acceptance of puffed pellets was unclear; another inferred that feed shape outweighs palatability.

Most of this is background citation of a single report, and other species (turbot, Atlantic salmon, grass carp) respond differently, so it does not transfer directly.

Results on growth and intake are mixed: background reports say juveniles grew worse than on fish chunks, large fish grew no differently from those fed fresh or chilled fish, and one inference suggests soft pellets may be less palatable than live prey. One measured trial of hybrid mandarin fish gave 74.33% training success and 60.00% survival over 90 days.

basis.summary: Most weight rests on the measured claims from paper S177 (1989), supported by the two 2018 papers' findings on slower growth than live fish and normal growth over 35 days; I reported the mixed and counterevidence claims (slower growth, late mortality) alongside the protein-dependent gains, and left out purely descriptive claims.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, force-feeding formulated feed gave growth that depended on dietary protein: higher protein gave better weight gain and feed efficiency, a very low-protein feed led to weight loss, and fish grew normally over 35 days in one study. However, force-fed formulated feed gave slower weight gain than live fish, and some fish died late in the trial; force-fed live fish grew faster than naturally fed ones, with similar feed conversion.
statement_zh: 鳜强制填喂配合饲料时，生长与饲料蛋白水平有关：蛋白越高，增重和饲料效率越好，蛋白过低则体重下降；有研究中幼鳜填喂35天生长正常。但填喂配合饲料的增重始终慢于投喂活饵鱼的组，养殖后期还出现了死亡；填喂活饵鱼比自然摄食的活饵鱼增重快，饲料系数相近。

basis.summary: I gave most weight to the measured claims (C10286, C12871, C12969), which come from three different papers and split between good acclimation results and poor success or molecular changes; I included the background claims C16718 and C9008 as secondary and left out C10253, which only states that feed technology was achieved without measuring welfare, and I reported the disagreement openly instead of choosing one side.

statement_en: The claims on feed-acclimated mandarin fish point in different directions. One paper measured over 80% acclimation and a feed coefficient of about 1.1 in ponds, and a background claim says fish on formulated feed did as well as or better than live-prey fish on several indicators. Against this, measured results show an average success of about 40% from acclimation to adult fish (versus 80-90% for traditional fry-fed culture), significantly lower expression of taste receptor genes t1r1 and t1r3 versus live-prey fish, and in one study a low acclimation rate with only 36.9% survival after 60 days despite high growth.
statement_zh: 配合饲料驯化养殖翘嘴鳜的结果并不一致。一项池塘实测驯化率超过80%、饲料系数约1.1,另有背景性说法称驯化后吃配合饲料的鳜在多项指标上与活饵组相当或更好。但也有实测显示,从驯化到成鱼的平均成功率只有约40%(传统鱼仔鳜养殖为80%-90%),饲料驯食组味觉受体t1r1、t1r3基因表达较活饵组显著下调;还有研究养殖60天虽然增重快,但驯食率低、成活率仅36.9%。

basis.summary: Most claims are suggestions or background statements without measured welfare effects, so I gave the weight to the one claim that says live-food dependence was solved and the one that says acceptance problems remain, and presented them as a disagreement.

statement_en: Most claims only say that formulated feed for mandarin fish should be developed to match its nutritional and feeding needs, without measured welfare results. One 1998 paper claims it has solved the live-food dependence that limited intensive farming, while a 2025 background claim says low acceptance of artificial feed, protein balance and palatability are still difficult.
statement_zh: 多数结论只是建议按鳜鱼的营养生理和摄食特点开发配合饲料，并没有实测的福利结果。1998年有一篇文章称配合饲料已解决了活饵依赖限制集约化养殖的问题，但2025年的背景性论述指出，人工饲料适口性差、摄食接受度低、蛋白需求难以平衡的问题依然存在。

basis.summary: Three of the four claims (from different papers) only describe or assert that feed properties matter, with no measured welfare outcome, while the one counter-claim is an inference about slower growth on non-specific feed, so I stated the description first and flagged the counterpoint as a possible explanation only.

statement_en: The claims mostly describe rather than measure: formulated feed is said to suit mandarin fish feeding and digestion when its nutrition and physical properties (shape, colour, moisture, texture, feeding stimulants, density) are right. One paper suggests that a non-mandarin-specific feed (grouper feed) may be why fish on feed grew significantly slower than those on live prey.
statement_zh: 这几条结论大多只是描述，没有直接测定效果：配合饲料如果营养配比和物理性状（形状、颜色、含水量、质地、促摄食物质、密度等）合适，被认为适合鳜摄食和消化。另有一篇推测，用非鳜专用饲料（石斑鱼饲料）可能是饲料组生长速度显著低于活饵组的原因。

statement_en: Two 2026 papers claim, without reporting measured welfare outcomes, that formulated-feed training of mandarin fish fry supports feeding without live prey fish. One aims to keep the training success rate above 80% by standardising the process, and the other says trained fry on specialised feed remove the dependence on live feed fish and its unstable supply.

statement_en: The four claims are mixed and mostly descriptive, with no measured welfare outcomes. Three say that replacing trash fish with formulated feed works, including healthy winter rearing at low water temperature and progress in feed training, while one reports that during the switch mandarin fish accept the feed poorly and show weak gut and liver function.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, frozen feed fish were readily eaten, and in one paper weight gain and survival did not differ significantly from live bait. Digestive findings were mixed: lipase activity was higher with frozen feed in some comparisons, but the same study also reported tissue damage and reduced digestive capacity for frozen and artificial feed.
statement_zh: 鳜鱼能很容易摄食冷冻饵料鱼，一项研究中冰冻饵料鱼组的增重率和成活率与鲜活饵料鱼组没有显著差异。消化方面结果不一：冷冻饲料组的脂肪酶活性在部分比较中较高，但同一研究也报告了组织损伤以及对冷冻和人工饲料的消化能力下降。
